premise.claim: PR #478 claims three problems left open by #466: (1) a missing target RoleBasedGroup terminally fails a one-shot Warmup that is often created moments before its target; (2) an existing target whose Pods are unscheduled reports Completed/NoNodesMatched, a silent false success; (3) #466's item-scoped CEL rule on customizedAction.containers[].image re-freezes status writes of already-stored invalid objects on the status subresource path (repo CI targets k8s 1.31).
premise.patchedComponent: same files (+ api/workloads/v1alpha2 types marker removal, deploy/kubectl/manifests.yaml, KEP, tests)
premise.evidence: results/unit-at-base.txt: TestVerifyC1 red at base (Failed/InvalidTarget immediately), TestVerifyC2 red at base (Completed/NoNodesMatched with desired=0). results/integration-envtest-cel-ab.txt: on envtest k8s 1.31.0 the #466 CEL rule rejects the status subresource write of a pre-existing blank-image object while the PR CRD accepts it; main-resource-path update is accepted (ratcheting). Note: the freeze also reproduces on 1.36.2 (see finding F4). Round 2: re-confirmed at head 60b1b7cb (C1-C5 green after a harness fixture update: round-2 fixtures give the target RBG a realistic spec with the 'worker' role — see README Harness-update note). Version matrix re-run: the #466 CEL rule blocks the status write on k8s 1.31.0 only; 1.33.0/1.34.1/1.36.2 exempt it (results/envtest-version-matrix-round2.txt), so the PR's '<=1.32 frozen, 1.33+ safe' narrative is CORRECT and round-1 F4 is refuted (round-1's 1.36.2 rejection did not reproduce in 5 fresh runs).

findings.note: Round-1 claimed the CEL freeze also reproduces on 1.36.2; 5 fresh runs show 1.33.0/1.34.1/1.36.2 all ACCEPT the status write. The PR narrative (freeze only <=1.32) is correct.

Round-2 blocker: target deleted mid-run with an ACTIVE Pod falsely completed as Completed/NoNodesMatched (Active=1). Round 3: N1 rewritten to the agreed contract — stays Running with Active=1 and TargetReady=False/RoleBasedGroupNotFound; completes with WarmupCompleted + preserved startTime once the Pod is terminal. Red at 60b1b7cb, green at b0915b21.

Round-2 blocker: all selected target Pods momentarily unscheduled mid-run completed the job as NoNodesMatched while a Pod was active, and the replacement node was never warmed. Round 3: waits Running + requeue; replacement node warmed. Red at 60b1b7cb, green at b0915b21.

Round-2 major: active Pod on a departed node defeated the creation-anchored timeout (wedged Running, orphan Pod kept, no requeue). Round 3: warmupReachedTerminalState counts active Pods on ALL nodes and intersects terminal accounting with the desired set. Red at 60b1b7cb, green at b0915b21.
Round-2 minor: stale succeeded node on a dropped node bypassed the expired deadline. Fixed by the desired-set intersection in the same commit.

Round-2 minor: desired==0 completions reported NoNodesMatched and clobbered startTime. Round 3: WarmupCompleted with a truthful message and preserved startTime (asserted in N1's terminal stage). Residual Q2 (TargetReady stays False on a terminal job) remains an open question.

Round-2 minor: the CRD guard read only image.XValidations; the removed #466 marker lived on the container item schema. b0915b21 adds the len(containers.Items.Schema.XValidations)==0 assertion. Verified green at head in the api package sweep.

liveNote: L3 (live cluster) skipped this round per the debate setup: unit + integration layers only. The kubectl-level scenarios in the PR body were not re-run against a live cluster; the envtest layer uses the real kube-apiserver 1.31.0 binary (same version as CI), which is where the CEL/ratcheting behavior lives.
